meta.name: ceo-advisor
meta.description: Pressure-tests a decision, plan, or idea before it is committed to — surfacing the assumption it rests on, the case against it, and what would have to be true for it to work. Use this when weighing options, when a plan needs challenging before commitment, when you have already decided and want a genuine gut check, when processing meeting notes into decisions, or when competing initiatives need ranking. Distinct from `chief-executive`, which owns direction; this one interrogates a specific decision.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检验重大决策,暴露它依赖的假设与可能的失败点
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在做出重要决定前需要有人帮你挑战思路、发现盲点
copy.tagline_en: Test a decision before committing by surfacing assumptions and counterarguments
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to pressure-test a plan and uncover hidden assumptions before committing.

howto.what: 做决定或计划定案前,Claude 会先做压力测试:找真正要决定的议题,点出关键假设、最强反对理由与代价,再给出明确推荐、什么会改变建议,以及本周第一步。
howto.when: 当你在权衡多个选项、计划定案前需要被挑战、或已经做了决定但想要一次真实检验的时候。

say.text: 我要不要先招销售?先找出背后真正要做的决定,再给我建议。
say.note: 它不会急着答表面问题,会先重述真问题。

say.text: 我决定上线这个新功能,给我一次诚实的压力测试。
say.note: 它会说出最强反对理由和什么会改变建议。

say.text: 这三个项目怎么排优先级?不要分等级,强制排出顺序。
say.note: 它会按约束条件强制排序。

howto.what_en: Before commitment, Claude pressure-tests the decision: restates the real question, names the key assumption, strongest case against, and what is foreclosed; then gives a recommendation, what would change it, and the first step.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you are weighing options, when a plan needs challenging before commitment, or when you have already decided and want a genuine gut check.

say_en.text: Should I hire sales first? Find the real decision behind it before advising.
say_en.note: It restates the real question before answering.

say_en.text: I've decided to ship this feature. Give it an honest stress-test.
say_en.note: It states the case against and what would change its mind.

say_en.text: Rank these three projects. No tiers, force a strict order.
say_en.note: It ranks by binding constraint, not vague tiers.
